_comment: Sokoban GAME rules (ADR 0009). Metagame layer: scoring, win conditions, restart. Subscribes to world/physics events. Multi-box levels need a count-based win check rather than first-contact (a single box-on-goal would early-transition).

rules._comment: Track move count — subscribe to physics's player_moved signal. Decoupled from physics so a 'move-counter-free' game variant could omit this rule.
Restart input: R reloads the current level. world.current_level is the engine-managed binding to the current level id.

Win-check via count: clock.on_goal_count accumulates box-goal contacts each tick (react phase, contact rule below); decide-phase rules read it (using PREVIOUS tick's accumulator) to compute is_won, then transition if won, then reset for next tick's count. Order within a tick: compute_is_won → win_when_all_placed → reset_on_goal_count → (react: count_box_on_goal). Read order via JSON registration, no explicit before/after needed since they all share the same tick interval.
Once is_won=1, transition to next level. Past last level → engine sets world.all_levels_complete=1.
Reset count for next round of contact accumulation (this tick's react phase). Runs LAST in decide so compute_is_won sees the previous tick's accumulator.
Each box-goal overlap contributes +1 to clock.on_goal_count. Fires in react phase AFTER reset_on_goal_count cleared the slate.
